cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll sort this out. You ended your message with 'take care'. That's how my last breakup started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you had a cold. I meant get better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll talk when I'm better. That's when he left too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll heat it. Use a pot you don't need back; that was his last kindness too.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 declares a plan to sort the message out; A3 adapts timing to B health explanation but treats it as prior abandonment; A5 accepts soup work while arranging the container as a final kindness.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 cold explains the care message; A contrary inference is the character fear, not a confirmed breakup. A1 last breakup supplies the antecedent for A3 he and A5 his.

relationship.evidence: B2 clarifies intent and B4 supplies ordinary practical care for a cold.

heightening.evidence: B4 soup becomes A5 a repeated last gesture, making the return-free container the next concrete instruction.

specificity.evidence: A1 message, past breakup and B2 cold clearly distinguish actual care from A feared interpretation.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 heating offer, container instruction and past-kindness comparison work together to keep B involved while forecasting loss.
